article.headline: Cameron Grant scores 19 as UNC Greensboro beats Milligan 96-43
article.description: — Cameron Grant had 19 points in UNC Greensboro’s 96-43 win against Milligan on Tuesday as the Spartans made a winning start to the season.
article.linkText: Cameron Grant scores 19 as UNC Greensboro beats Milligan 96-43
article.story: GREENSBORO, N.C. -- — Cameron Grant had 19 points in UNC Greensboro’s 96-43 win against Milligan on Tuesday as the Spartans made a winning start to the season. Grant also contributed nine rebounds and three blocks. R.J. Greer scored 15 points and added five rebounds. Dionte Neal finished 7 for 8 from the field with 14 points. William Robinson finished with 10 points for the Buffs. Milligan also got eight points and six rebounds from Te’Jon McDaniel-McCormick. Bo Koebbe also had six points. Up next UNC Greensboro plays at Elon on Friday, and Milligan visits Lipscomb on Sunday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
